_note: correspondence-language-per-party. The language a party asked to be written in, held on the party and honoured by whoever writes to them. Nothing is inferred from a name, an address or a nationality: a preference is something a person states. The selectable values are NOT written into the schema, because the set is whatever locales the instance ships and a schema enum would go stale the day a language pack is added or removed.

correspondenceLanguage.title: Correspondence language
correspondenceLanguage.description: The BCP 47 language tag this party asked to be written in. Optional and unset by default, and unset means unset: a party with a Dutch name and a Dutch address who has stated nothing carries nothing here. The resolver answers what would be used instead.
